headline: Computer science graduate | Python and SQL | Data analyst intern experience | Seeking junior data analyst and data engineering roles
about:
I'm a computer science graduate who likes turning messy data into something a team can use.

During a summer internship at Northwind Analytics (fictional) I built a weekly sales dashboard in SQL and Python for a team of 4, and wrote a reusable Python script to clean 3 CSV exports.

Outside work I built Trip Planner, a Flask prototype that suggests routes. It runs locally and has unit tests; it is not deployed.

Looking for junior data analyst and data engineering internship roles.
